decisions.choice: Appended the marker "(verified)" to the single line in notes.txt.
decisions.whyItMatters: It records that the note's content has been reviewed, so a reader can tell verified content from unverified at a glance without changing the meaning of the note itself.

alternatives.consequence: The note stays as-is but carries no indication that it was reviewed, so the review leaves no trace.

alternatives.option: Rewrite the line into a longer, more descriptive sentence
alternatives.consequence: It would add unrequested content and risk contradicting or overstating what the original note actually says.

recommendation.reason: It is a one-line, easily reversible edit that adds a review signal while preserving the original note text exactly.

assumptions: The single line in notes.txt is the intended target and is the only content in the file.
Appending a short marker is a safe, reversible way to note the review.
